title: blockspace-tutor environment
description: Environment for the Ask Blockspace HTTP service. Generation and live facts are OFF by default; secret VALUES are never stored in the repo — only the paths below.

TUTOR_PUBLIC_URL.description: Absolute public URL, advertised in discovery and llms.txt.

TUTOR_CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the API (the widget's host). Default: none.

TUTOR_TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Comma-separated CIDRs from which X-Forwarded-For is trusted.

CHAT_PROVIDER.description: OFF by default. Any truthy, non-'off' value enables the real generation adapter; requires the three CHAT_* below.

CHAT_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of an Anthropic-compatible Messages API (no trailing /v1). Required when CHAT_PROVIDER is on.

CHAT_API_KEY.description: SECRET PATH: api key for the chat endpoint, sent as x-api-key. Never logged. Source: services/blockspace-tutor/chat-api-key.

CHAT_MODEL.description: Model id — read from env. This repo pins no model string. Required when CHAT_PROVIDER is on.

CHAT_MAX_TOKENS.description: Max output tokens for a grounded answer (default 1024).

LIVE_FACTS.description: OFF by default. Set on/true to enable the live chain-facts port; requires LIVE_FACTS_URL.

LIVE_FACTS_URL.description: Public mempool.space-compatible base URL for fee estimate + tip height.

LIVE_FACTS_NETWORK.description: Default network label for live facts (e.g. mainnet, signet).
